prompt_template.WHAT: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a single named NPC. Same composition rules as Survivor Portrait but more interior-scene context allowed.
prompt_template.STYLE: 2D painted survival-portrait. ASHFALL palette. Continuity with Survivor-Portrait, but slightly broader expressive range permitted.
prompt_template.COMPOSITION: Same as Survivor Portrait but background may carry a doorway or wall fragment.
prompt_template.LIGHTING: Same as Survivor Portrait, may carry a slightly warmer key light indicating warmth source (candle, low fire).
prompt_template.PALETTE: charcoal #2A2A2C, concrete grey #5C5F62, faded blue-grey #708085, rust brown #6E4A2F, dirty bone #B5A88A. Accents limited to muted amber #A26E2C (1-2% of pixels) and subtle cyan-green #4F7461 only for contamination iconography.
prompt_template.BACKGROUND: Slight scene context (doorway, wall, frost-rimed doorway). Soft-bokeh beyond depth-of-field.
prompt_template.RUNTIME_READABILITY: Reads at 128×128 NPC roster card. Silhouette retains character at 64×64.
prompt_template.NEGATIVE: no real-world text, letters, or numerals; no logos or watermark; no AI signature glyphs; no anime-style eyes outside portrait family; no fantasy ornament or fleurons; no neon cyberpunk glow borders; no glossy 3D chromatic rendering; no crystalline particles; no stock-photo backdrop; no pristine factory-fresh finish on tools or weapons; no gratuitous gore; no real-country flags; no real brand marks. No rendered UI text — that is authored in Godot.
